name: Yo Momma Jokes
tagline: Lightweight random yo-momma joke API for bots and novelty demos
description: A free, no-auth public API that returns a single random yo-momma joke as JSON. Popular for chatbots, Discord/Slack bots, demos, and fun side projects. Simple GET endpoint with no signup required; response is a short joke string. Ideal when you need instant novelty humor without keys or SDKs.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoint; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no published quota (usage may be rate-limited at infrastructure level)

example.response_snippet: {"joke":"Yo momma so fat, when she sat on an iPhone, it turned into an iPad!"}

use_cases: get a random yo-momma joke for a chatbot reply
power a Discord or Slack novelty slash command
demo a simple public JSON API in a tutorial
add random humor to a CLI or terminal greeting
seed joke content for a fun web widget
